verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents travel-booking virtual cards (VCN), travel-specific cards, and linking receipts to transactions. There is no evidence that trip expenses are automatically grouped into a single report tied to an itinerary. These are adjacent building blocks, not the story's trip-report capability.

support.subject: As an employee, a trip's expenses — bookings, cards, receipts — collect themselves into one itinerary-linked report
